name: Faithful
overview: Scripture reveals that faithfulness is both a divine attribute and a human responsibility. God is described as the faithful God who keeps His covenant and mercy to those who love Him (Deuteronomy 7:9), and His mercies and compassions never fail (Lamentations 3:22). Believers are called to embody faithfulness through steadfast love and truth, which lead to blessing and reward (Proverbs 3:3; Proverbs 28:20; Psalms 31:23). The faithful servant is commended and entrusted with greater responsibility, highlighting the reward of faithfulness in service to the Lord (Matthew 25:21).
